reasoning_content:
Got the MinIO server binary (76MB) from GitHub. Interesting that the HTTP code line didn't get printed, but the size is shown. Let me verify this and grab mc too.

Next, about the Docker images. The `minio/minio` and `minio/mc` images can't be pulled. I need to build local images from these binaries. Let me check the remaining docker pull progress and uv sync.

Let me verify the minio binary works, and download mc too.

action.command:
cd /tmp
chmod +x minio_server 2>/dev/null
echo "=== verify minio server runs ==="; timeout 20 ./minio_server --version 2>&1 | head -3
echo "=== download mc client ==="
MCTAG="RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z"
timeout 180 curl -sSL -o mc "https://github.com/minio/mc/releases/download/${MCTAG}/mc.linux-amd64.${MCTAG}" -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"
chmod +x mc 2>/dev/null; echo "=== mc version ==="; timeout 20 ./mc --version 2>&1 | head -3
